description:
Returns the placeholders that the `subject` and `message` of the email templates accept,
such as `defaults.subject` in `GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/email-configuration`. Write a
placeholder, braces included, wherever the value should appear: it is replaced when the
email is sent.

- **Scope:** the catalogue is the same for every credential and does not depend on any
  account or company, so the operation takes no identifier.
- **Unknown placeholders:** a placeholder that is not listed is sent as written.

**Closed catalogue.** This collection is fixed and bounded: it carries no `pagination`, it
takes no `page`/`limit`, and every response holds the whole set.

BeeL API endpoint: GET /v1/email-template-variables (reference: https://docs.beel.es)
name: beel_list_email_template_variables
